<View style={{ backgroundColor: theme.bgBase, padding: 16, gap: 8,
    ...(scope === 'app' ? { flex: 1, paddingTop: 48 } : {}) }} testID="runtime-error">
    <Text accessibilityRole="alert" style={{ ...theme.type.bodyStrong, color: theme.textPrimary }}>
      {scope === 'app' ? 'Beeline could not display this screen' : 'Conversation mode could not start'}
    </Text>
    <ScrollView style={{ maxHeight: 256 }}>
      <Text selectable style={{ ...theme.type.body, color: theme.textPrimary }} testID="runtime-error-message">{diagnostic.message}</Text>
      {diagnostic.stack ? (
          <Text selectable style={{ ...theme.type.meta, color: theme.textSecondary }} testID="runtime-error-stack">{diagnostic.stack}</Text>
        ) : null}
    </ScrollView>
    <Button
      label="Retry"
      accessibilityLabel="Retry"
      onPress={retry}
      emergencyTheme={theme}
      variant="quiet"
      testID="runtime-error-retry"
      appearance={{
        control: { minHeight: 44, justifyContent: 'center' },
        label: { ...theme.type.bodyStrong, color: theme.accent },
      }}
    />
  </View>

jsx:
<SettingsRow
                title="Allow fix sweep"
                description="Helps Beeline improve"
                testID="workspace-fix-sweep"
                toggle={{
                  value: workspaceView?.managerSettings?.allowFixSweep === true,
                  disabled: workingKey !== null || typeof workspaceView?.managerSettings?.allowFixSweep !== 'boolean',
                  onValueChange: (allowFixSweep) => {
                    if (!communityId) return;
                    setErrorRow('fix-sweep');
                    setWorkingKey('fix-sweep');
                    setError(null);
                    void monolithPhoneOperation('updateWorkspace', { workspaceId: communityId, allowFixSweep })
                      .then(() => workspaceSchedulerRef.current?.force())
                      .catch((caught) => setError(`Could not update Allow fix sweep: ${String(caught)}`))
                      .finally(() => setWorkingKey(null));
                  },
                }}
              />
